request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the one sign number described (12): no other signs, screens, clocks, tickets, trains, planes or clothes show any digit.

Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Image 1 shows Luis. Keep the face, hair, skin and build exactly; dress him in his navy crew-neck T-shirt with a grey backpack on his back. Create a new photograph inside an airport: Luis stands by a row of grey seats at a departure gate and smiles at the camera. Through the big window behind him a white airplane without logos or writing waits at the jet bridge. On the wall beside the window is one big square yellow sign with one huge black number: 12. The number is upright, sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. Only Luis is near the camera; nobody else is clearly visible.
